# Earth Right Now — The Live Discovery Engine

> See before you go.

Earth Right Now (ERN) is a Live Discovery Search Engine for discovering what real places around Earth look like now through curated live video, refreshed current images and provider-hosted live sources.

Canonical site: https://earthrightnow.app/

## Core public pages
- Home: https://earthrightnow.app/
- Places directory: https://earthrightnow.app/places/
- Discover directory: https://earthrightnow.app/discover/
- About: https://earthrightnow.app/about.html
- How ERN works: https://earthrightnow.app/how-ern-works.html
- Live & current source policy: https://earthrightnow.app/source-policy.html
- Editorial & curation principles: https://earthrightnow.app/editorial-principles.html
- FAQ: https://earthrightnow.app/faq.html
- Privacy: https://earthrightnow.app/privacy.html
- Sitemap: https://earthrightnow.app/sitemap.xml

## Source truth
ERN distinguishes:
- embedded live streams,
- provider-hosted external live streams,
- refreshed current images,
- sources awaiting recheck,
- degraded/unavailable sources,
- reference-only material.

A reachable provider page is not by itself proof that a stream or image is current. Destination pages expose provider attribution and the latest reliable ERN verification time where available.

## Attribution
Third-party cameras, streams and source pages remain owned/operated by their providers unless explicitly stated otherwise. ERN acts as a discovery bridge and curator.

## Editorial principles
Quality over quantity. Payment or affiliate commission does not buy Earth-window ranking. Stale/reference-only material is not relabeled LIVE.

## Gated future features
The public generative ERN Guide and public 45-minute Now Moment media are not activated. Future Local Earth, Now Moments, live context and serendipitous discovery should add genuinely useful current-world information, not SEO filler.

This file is an optional machine-readable orientation aid. The authoritative public content remains ERN's crawlable HTML pages, destination pages, sitemap, canonical URLs and structured data.
